div.p: A Dynamic Content block displays dynamically generated content that can be automatically changed based on any criteria, such as data in an instance, time of day, roles, or whether or not a user is logged in. Dynamic Content blocks are very powerful, written using the same Jelly scripting language used in UI Macros and UI Pages.

div.name: ${jvar_clicklink_id}
div.p: Click here${SP}to configure this reusable Dynamic Content block.
